attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one premium anime game cinematic character cut-in, true transparent background, landscape 1536 x 1024.

Primary request: create ONE dynamic ATTACK / taking-the-initiative portrait of the exact Lv1 baby cyan dragon from the references. This is a new action illustration, not a contact sheet or a repeat of the static reaction bust.

Reference image 1, lv1_sheet_cyan.jpg: authoritative character anatomy and permanent color/marking identity.
Reference image 2, joy-v4.png: approved modern rendering style, precise facial identity and proportions. Match this polished anime look, crisp dark outlines, luminous green eyes, glossy cyan scales, soft controlled cel shading. Do not copy the static straight-on pose.

Identity: cute baby dragon with cyan/turquoise body, mint/light-green round cheeks and segmented belly, large emerald eyes, two short upward curved ring-banded pale mint horns, a larger upright mint central head fin, mint central forehead diamond with two smaller separate leaf marks, cyan cheek fins with mint accent fins, two small bat wings with mint membranes. Keep the rounded baby muzzle and chubby proportions. No crown, halo, collar, clothing, weapons or extra decorations.

Pose / emotion: lively confident playful initiative, waist-up three-quarter pose leaning diagonally toward the viewer's right. Head turned toward viewer, open bright focused eyes, determined cheerful grin with tiny ivory teeth. One small clenched forepaw projects forward, the other draws back close to torso; correctly attached short baby arms with compact simple clawed paws, no extra limbs. Wings open slightly behind the shoulders as if starting a little forward dash. The gesture should feel brave and energetic, adorable rather than threatening. No impact on a victim, no opponent, no gore, no violent scene. Clearly different from the front-facing joy reaction bust.
Composition: centered isolated character, entire horns, head fins, both paws and small wings fully visible inside roughly 7 percent safe margin. Large readable face at upper center, complete upper torso with a deliberate clean curved lower silhouette above the lower margin. No feet or ground. A sweeping diagonal silhouette suitable for overlay on different games. Do not reserve half the canvas for lettering: the app will place text separately.
Rendering: polished high-quality hand-drawn Japanese anime fantasy board-game illustration, crisp varying dark teal outlines, appealing expressive face, carefully structured cel shading and restrained glossy highlights. Match the established character without aging it into an adult. No photorealism or 3D toy render.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, completely empty between and around limbs and wings. No painted checkerboard, colored matte, white/black rectangular background, scene, floor, drop shadow or vignette. No large aura or detached effects needed.
Text: none. Avoid letters, numbers, cards, board pieces, labels, border, logo, watermark, collage, multiple views, cropped horns or wings, duplicated fingers.
